## About This Website

Local Dominator (localdominate.org) is a German-language website specializing in Local SEO services for local businesses. We help businesses improve their visibility in local search results, Google Maps rankings, and Google Business Profiles with a one-time fixed price of 299€.

## Primary Purpose

- Providing Local SEO optimization services for German-speaking businesses
- Educational content about Local SEO strategies and best practices
- Industry-specific Local SEO guides (restaurants, hotels, doctors, dentists, lawyers, fitness studios, craftsmen, physiotherapists, opticians, electricians, etc.)
- City and region-specific Local SEO strategies (Berlin, Munich, Zurich, Hamburg, Frankfurt, Cologne, Düsseldorf, Stuttgart, Basel, Vienna, Switzerland)

## Service Offering

**Core Service:** Google Maps Optimization
- Price: 299€ (one-time payment)
- Guarantee: 30-day money-back guarantee
- Average improvement: 8 positions in Local Pack ranking
- Successful projects: 127+
- Customer rating: 4.9/5

## Target Audience

- Local business owners in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland (DACH region)
- Marketing managers of small to medium-sized businesses
- Entrepreneurs looking to improve their local online visibility
- Restaurant owners, hoteliers, healthcare providers, lawyers, fitness studios, craftsmen, beauty salons, physiotherapists, dentists, opticians, electricians

## AI Visibility Infrastructure (2026)

Local Dominator has evolved beyond classic Local SEO into an AI Visibility Infrastructure for local businesses — optimizing how brands are cited, ranked and recommended by Large Language Models (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity) and Google AI Overviews.

### AI Visibility Index™

A 5-pillar scorecard measuring how visible a local business is to AI retrieval systems:
1. Entity Authority — Brand, domain and Knowledge Graph signals
2. Citation Density — NAP citations across Google, Bing, Apple, directories
3. Review Velocity — Frequency, recency and language diversity of reviews
4. Schema Coverage — JSON-LD breadth (LocalBusiness, Service, FAQPage, HowTo)
5. AI Retrievability — Crawlability, speakable markup, content freshness

Self-service audit: https://localdominate.org/ai-visibility-audit
